[set_budget, over_budget] -> accepted (rev-0006)

`set_budget(category, amount)` stores the per-category monthly budget in `state.budgets` and returns the amount (setting the same category again replaces it; a negative budget throws), and `over_budget()` returns the names of categories whose spending exceeds their budget, sorted alphabetically — spending exactly the budget is not over.

over_budget() => {"ok":true,"value":["food"],"replayed":false}
